name: 20-convert-claude-prompt-basic
description: convertClaudePrompt (prompt-converters.js:120-186), the default message format: no assistant postfix, no system-prompt support and no excluded prefixes. The first turn is forced to role 'user' (:164) -- even though it was a system message going in -- and a 'FixHumMsg' rewrite is *not* triggered, because the assistant turn sits at index 2 so the candidate at index 1 is checked against `i - 1 !== 0` and stays 'user' (:166-168). Every turn is then prefixed from the table at :175-180 and joined into one string; the system turn at index 0 gets the empty prefix, and the tool_calls array is stringified onto the end of its content (:128-130).

args.content: Good evening to you as well.
